Appearance

Broad-shouldered veteran with a scarred cheek and calm, steady bearing. Always watching the shoreline.

What We Know

Captain of Ardenville's lake guard. Commands patrols that keep monsters and smugglers in check across Lake Arden. Hires adventurers for dangerous work in the kelp beds and near the collapsing warehouse.

First Impressions

Quiet authority. Not a man who wastes words — but when he speaks, people listen.
